entries.summary: A 3B model has a hard ceiling: answers get shallow, grammar and instruction-following slip on anything multi-step, and code quality is limited.

mitigations.note: Scope it to what Meta built it for — summarization, rewriting, extraction, short Q&A — one small task per prompt.
For real coding or multi-step work, move up to an 8B+ model.

citations.title: Academic evaluation of small-model coding/feedback quality
